detail:
What the creator claims:

• Mitochondria work like rechargeable batteries — they have to be recharged.
• Natural ways to recharge them (grounding, sunlight, minerals, and other natural processes) work at a slower pace.
• For people with chronic illness or autoimmune disease whose "batteries are running on empty," he presents frequency medicine (frequency-specific microcurrent) as the faster clinical option.

The creator's own caption: "For educational purposes only. Not medical advice."

This is a summary of what the source claims — Tabs is not endorsing or verifying it. Talk to your doctor before trying anything here.
